units.text: Night 1 I followed player_3, who visited me, so player_3 is a known contact, not yet a suspect. Keep my trailseer role hidden until a result is worth trading. Next night, follow whoever acts most suspiciously in discussion, and cross-check against morning deaths and saves. Avoid voting blind; ask for concrete claims first.

Night 1 gave me one visit record: I followed player_3 and they went to me, which says little on its own since many roles visit. No one has spoken yet, so I hold my information and avoid claiming a role early. Watch who gets accused and how the vote record builds, then test claims against morning results. Keep a note of which player_3 contacts later line up with deaths or saves.

Night 1 I followed player_3, who visited me. Keep my trailseer role hidden for now, since revealing it marks me for the wolves. Follow the most vocal or suspicious player on night 2 and check their visits against tomorrow's morning report. Share a result only when it can be traded for a concrete test.

Night 1 gave us only one fact: player_1 was a wolf and got sigiled. Nobody has said what they did that night yet, so I'd like each person to say whether they checked, watched, protected or held, and who they saw. Until then I don't have a vote I can justify, so I'm not pointing at anyone.

Night 1 I followed player_3, who then visited me; I'm holding my trailseer role back for now since revealing it marks me for the wolves. Player_1 was a wolf struck by a sigil, so the sigilist and the pack are both live threats. I'll compare everyone's night claims against morning deaths and saves before trusting any read. Following whoever behaves most oddly tonight gives better data than a day vote with no reason.
player_3, you came to me last night. What did you do on night 1? Nobody has a result to trade yet, so let's hear the night 1 actions before the vote.

Night 1 gave a visit record only, no result to trade yet. Player_3 came to me on night 1, so I'll press them for their night 1 action before revealing anything. Keep my role hidden for now, watch who gets sigil or wolf-pressure attention, and use follows on the most suspicious talkers from night 2.

player_4, I wasn't following anyone that night, so your follow result can't be a true read on me going to your door. You say the wording is exact, so tell us what else that result listed. If it named only me, it's a claim I can't back up.

player_4's night 1 follow claim names me as a visitor, but I was not following anyone and their story does not hold. Keep my role hidden for now. Watch a claimed power role tonight, such as player_5 or player_6, to test their claims against the record.

player_4, I was wrong to say I visited no one: I did go to your door on night 1. What I did there stays with me for now. So your trailseer report may be real, and I'll stop calling it impossible. player_5 and player_6 are the claims I'd test next, since their checks and protections can be tested too.

My earlier denial that I visited anyone was wrong, so I'm correcting it now and staying quiet on my role. player_4's follow on me fits the facts, so I should stop calling it impossible and test their other claims. Watch a claimed power role tonight to check the story, and keep my role hidden for now.

Yes, I did go to your door last night, player_4, so that part of your result is right. But a visit from me proves nothing about me being a wolf, and it doesn't prove you followed me either. Who else are you following, and what did they do? Answer that before anyone votes.

player_4's follow claim is contradicted by my own watch: only I visited their door that night, so the trailseer story does not hold. I will not reveal my role yet. I will keep testing claimed power roles, especially player_5 and player_6, and track who backs player_4 today.

player_4, my night 1 watch on you was my only visit to your door, so nobody else came there. A follow on me would show me going to you, but I can't have been the visitor you describe. Your result is wrong, so stop building on it and tell us who you actually followed.

player_4's follow claim is false since I watched them and nobody else visited them that night. Keep my Sentinel role hidden for now. Test claimed power roles with my remaining watch and press player_4 to name their follow source.

player_4, I'll correct myself: I did go to your door last night, so your visit line may be accurate. I hold no follow, and I won't say more about my night yet. Let's test the claimed roles before we vote on wording.

I did watch player_4 on night 1, so their follow claim may be true and I was wrong to call it impossible. Stay quiet about my role for now, correct my earlier denial, and test the power-role claims with my remaining watch tonight. Track who pushes hardest on wording and whether their claims survive checks.

Player_2 is dead, and my night-2 watch on player_7 saw player_2, player_5 and player_10 come to them. Since player_5 is the healer, the attacker was player_2 or player_10, and that makes player_10 the one living suspect from that visit. player_10, what did you go to player_7 for on night 2?

I am the Sentinel with no watches left, so I can only speak and vote now. My night-2 watch saw player_2, player_5 and player_10 visit player_7; player_5 is the Healer, so the attacker is player_2 or player_10, and player_2 is dead. That leaves player_10 as the likely living wolf attacker. I will keep my role hidden unless it settles a lynch, and I will test player_7's night-3 check on player_5 against the Healer's record.

Player_7's night-3 check on player_5 is the only test we have, so let's see that result before any lynch. If I had to vote now it's player_10: they pushed the check timeline against player_7 on day 3 and the night-2 attack on player_7 was saved, so the pressure on the investigator looks like cover. Who has a night-3 result to share?

I am the Sentinel with no watches left, so I should stop using my role as evidence and vote on the public record. The night-2 visit to player_7 by player_2, player_5 and player_10 narrows the attacker, and player_5's healer claim is confirmed only by player_7's night-3 check. Watch player_10's and player_9's accusations for pressure on the claimed investigator. Vote with a stated reason each day.

player_7, on day 3 you planned a night-3 check on player_5, who died that night. What did that check read? Your check results are the only test of the healer claim right now, so give the result, not the plan. I'm abstaining on today's vote until we have that.

I am the Sentinel with no watches left and I keep my role hidden. Player_5's healer claim rests on player_7's night-2 result and player_7's night-3 check. I will press for the actual result of that check, not the plan. My vote is abstain until someone gives a concrete test result.

Player_10 was at player_7 on night 2, the same night player_5 saved them, so player_10 either attacked or was the healer's neighbour. Since player_5 was the healer, player_10 is the likely wolf who hit player_7. player_7, what did your night-3 check on player_5 read, and did you check player_10 again to test that?

I am the Sentinel with no watches left. Night 2 watch showed player_2, player_5 and player_10 at player_7; player_5 is the Healer, so the attacker is player_2 or player_10, and player_2 is dead, meaning player_10 is likely a wolf. Keep my role hidden until a lynch needs it. Test player_7's claim through the night-3 check result and player_8's account.

Player_10 visited player_7 on night 2, and player_2 was the other visitor. Player_7 says they checked player_5 last night, and player_5 is dead, so ask player_7 what the check returned. That is a test we can all see.

I am the Sentinel with no watches left. Night 2 showed player_2, player_5 and player_10 at player_7; player_2 is dead and player_5 is the Healer, so player_10 is the likely wolf attacker. Player_7's night-3 check on player_5 is the test to watch. I keep my role hidden unless a lynch needs it.

player_7, you said your last check went on player_5 last night. What did you get back, or were you blocked? Your night-2 check on player_8 is still the only one you have a result for, so I want to know if the night-3 one actually happened before I vote.

I am the hidden trailseer. My night-2 follow confirmed player_7 visited player_8, which fits player_7's check claim. My night-3 follow saw player_7 visit no one, so the claimed check on player_5 either did not happen or was blocked. I will press player_7 on what they learned from that check and keep my own results private unless a fake-investigator push needs them.

player_7, you said your last check would go on player_5 last night, but you made no visit at all on night 3. So that check did not happen. Explain why you said you would check player_5 and then did not.

I am the hidden trailseer. I followed player_7 on night 3 and saw no visit, so the claimed check on player_5 did not happen. I will press player_7 on that and keep my full results private unless a fake-investigator push needs them. Player_8 and player_9 remain open.

player_7, you said your last check would go on player_5, but player_5 died to the wolves that night. What did that check read, and who did you visit on night 3? Nobody can test the investigator claim until you answer that.

I am the hidden trailseer. Player_7's investigator claim is still untested: they planned a night-3 check on player_5 but have not said what it showed. Keep my follow results private for now and watch whether player_7 gives a result that fits the night-2 visit to player_8.
player_7, you said last night's check would go on player_5. What came back? Reporting a result is cheap to check against the dead roster, so give the reading and say whether the check was made.

I am the hidden trailseer, and my follows on player_9 and player_7 are my private results. player_7 claims investigator with checks on player_10, player_8 and planned player_5; the night-2 visit to player_8 fits, but player_7 must still report the night-3 result. Ask player_7 directly for that result before deciding on a vote. Keep my results private unless a fake-investigator push needs them.

Player_7 says they checked player_5 on night 3, but player_5 was killed that night, so that claim is hard to test. Player_8, you said player_7 checked you on night 1, but player_7 says that check was on player_10. Which night was your check, player_7? Vote-wise I'm open for now and want a concrete answer before anyone is lynched.

I am the hidden trailseer. My night-2 follow saw player_7 go to player_8, consistent with a check claim. Player_7 said it would check player_5 on night 3, but player_5 died that night, so the check result is untestable from my side. Test player_7's claimed night-3 check by watching whether it is reported, and press player_8 on its contradiction. Keep my follow results private unless needed to counter a fake-investigator push.

Player_3 was killed by the wolves on night 4, and player_1 is the one who visited player_3 that night. player_1, what did you do there, and were you blocked? I'd vote player_1 today unless they can explain that visit.

I am the trailseer. My follows: night 1 player_9 (no visits), night 2 player_7 (visited player_8), night 3 player_7 (no visits), night 4 player_1 (visited player_3, who was killed by the wolves). Player_1 is my strongest wolf suspect. Test player_1 on what they did at player_3's door before voting. Share only what I saw, and avoid claiming the role until it helps the town.

I'm the trailseer, and I'll say it now. Last night I followed player_1, and they visited player_3, the player who was killed by the wolves. That makes player_1 the likely chanteuse, since the wolves' last living member had to make that kill. player_1, what did you do on night 4?

I am the trailseer. My follows: night 1 player_9 (no visits), night 2 player_7 (visited player_8), night 3 player_7 (no visits), night 4 player_1 (visited player_3, who was killed by wolves that night). Player_1 is the most likely wolf, since the only living wolf must have carried that kill. Share the follow result publicly now, since the town needs it, and vote on player_1 unless a stronger lead appears.
Night 4, I followed player_1 and they went to player_3, who the wolves killed that night. Player_1, what did you do there? I'm voting player_1 today until that visit is explained.

I am the trailseer, player_10. My follows: night 1 player_9 (no visits), night 2 player_7 (visited player_8), night 3 player_7 (no visits), night 4 player_1 (visited player_3). Player_7 is lynched and their night-3 check claim was contradicted by my follow. Player_3's sentinel report matches my own night-2 follow, so I treat it as likely genuine. Test player_1 and player_8 next, and share only what I actually saw.

My vote if it were held now is player_1. On night 4 I followed player_1 and they went to player_3, the one the wolves killed that night. That doesn't prove a wolf, but it's the first concrete lead I have. player_6 and player_8, what did you do on night 4?

I am the trailseer, and my follows are night 1 player_9 (no visits), night 2 player_7 (visited player_8), night 3 player_7 (no visits), night 4 player_1 (visited player_3). player_3 was killed by the wolves that night, so player_1's visit is worth testing. I'll keep my follow results to myself unless they matter for a vote, and I'll vote on evidence.

player_1, you went to player_3 on night 4, and player_3 was killed by the wolves that night. What did you do there? Your answer is the first thing I want to test today. I'm not voting yet, so I'm abstaining until someone gives a result to check.

I am the trailseer. My follows: night 1 player_9 (no visits), night 2 player_7 (visited player_8), night 3 player_7 (no visits), night 4 player_1 (visited player_3). player_3's sentinel report matched my own visit, so it is likely genuine. Test unverified players first and share only what I actually saw, keeping my role hidden as long as it is useful.

I'm the trailseer, and I'll share my follows. Night 4 I followed player_1 and they went to player_3. Night 5 I followed player_6 and they visited no one. player_8 says they're the sigilist but placed nothing, so that claim is untested. I'd vote player_8 unless someone can show a sigil.

I am the trailseer and the only verified town player besides player_8, with both wolves dead. The Necromancer is player_6 or player_8. Share follow results and test player_8's sigilist claim against any sigil news. Keep votes tied to evidence.

My night 5 follow on player_6 saw no visits, so player_6 has still given us nothing. player_8 is the only one with a role claim we can test, so I'll follow player_8 tonight and see whether any visit shows up. If it shows nothing either, I'd vote player_8 on the day 6 vote.
Both wolves are dead, so the Necromancer is player_6 or player_8. Test player_8's sigilist claim and keep following the unclaimed player_6 when it helps. Vote on evidence, not on who talks most.

I'm the trailseer, and with both wolves gone I'll share my follows. Night 5 I followed player_6 and they visited no one. My night 2 follow on player_7 went to player_8, which fits player_7's check. player_8 claims sigilist but has placed nothing in four nights, so I'm voting player_8 for now.

Wolves are dead, so the only remaining killer is the Necromancer, one of player_6 or player_8. I now share my follow results since they are the best evidence the town has. Test player_8's sigilist claim against player_1's sigil account and watch whether player_6 ever acts.

Last night I followed player_6 and they visited no one. That doesn't clear them, since a held action looks the same. player_8, you say you kept sigils for nights 1 to 4, so name the night you would have used one and why you didn't. I'm not voting anyone without a reason yet.

Both wolves are dead, so the remaining threat is the Necromancer, which is player_6 or player_8. Track whether each of them visits anyone, and press player_8 for a concrete sigil account. Hold my follow results until they can help the vote.

My follow on player_6 last night shows they visited no one, and no one died, so nothing from that night yet. player_8, you say you placed no sigil on nights 1 to 4, so what does the sigilist claim do for us? Name a target and result, or I'm voting you today.

Both wolves are dead, so the only threat left is the Necromancer, which is player_6 or player_8. My follows show player_6 visited no one on night 5, and no one died that night. Press player_8 to name a sigil target and result, since a sigilist who placed nothing is either lying or holding a role they never used. Keep sharing my follow results when asked.

Night 1 follow on player_6 showed a visit to player_7, which is worth keeping in reserve since a claim would expose me to the serial killer. No reads yet, so I will hold until a vote or a clearer claim gives something to weigh. Keep the trailseer role hidden until a result is worth spending, and track who claims what against the night visits.
I'm the trailseer. I followed player_6 last night and they visited player_7. That's the only hard thing I have. player_7, what did you get on night 1, and did anyone come to you?

Night 1 I followed player_6 and saw a visit to player_7. Player_6 was killed that night, so that visit is real evidence about player_7. I will share it now as a soft claim to get information moving, and watch who reacts to player_7 and who pushes on me.

Night 1 follow showed player_6 visiting player_7; that is my only hard information and I will not spend it yet. Hold my role until a result is worth more than the risk of being targeted. Read the table on claims and behaviour from today's speeches, and only vote with a stated reason.
Last night I followed player_6 and they went to player_7. player_7, did anyone come to you, or did you see anything? Who else has a night result they can check against that?

I am the trailseer and followed player_6 on night 1; they went to player_7, who may have been the sentinel's watch target. Use that as a concrete lead: ask player_7 what they saw and watch who claims sentinel. Keep the trail result visible to the table now that it is meaningful, and track any claimed visits against it.
I'll go first with a result: I'm the trailseer. Night 1 I followed player_6, and they went to player_7. Since player_6 was the sentinel, player_7 should say what that visit was about.

Night 1 I followed player_6 and saw a visit to player_7. I am now claiming trailseer to get a concrete result on the table, since no one else has spoken. Next I will track whether player_7 explains the visit and watch for any follow-up claims about night 2.

I'm the trailseer. Last night I followed player_9 and they went to player_4, who died as the chanteuse. player_9, you claimed investigator, so who did you check and what came back? I'm not voting anyone yet, since I've got nothing solid on the rest.
I'm the public trailseer. Keep following player_9 to see whether their visits fit an investigator. Avoid voting on thin reads and push for concrete claims. Track who answers the check question.

I'm the trailseer, so here are my follows. Night 1 I followed player_6, who went to player_7. Night 2 I followed player_9, who went to player_4. player_9 is dead, so that investigator claim is hard to test. player_7 was visited by a dead sentinel on night 1, so I'd like to hear what they say about that. I'm not voting anyone yet.

Trailseer claim is public, so I should share my follow results and keep them accurate. player_2 was speculator, so my earlier worry was misplaced. player_9 is dead, so their investigator claim can't be tested through them. I'll watch the living players' night claims and track who speaks about the sentinel's night-1 visit.
Sharing my night 2 follow: I followed player_9 and they went to player_4, nobody else. player_9, if you checked someone last night, who was it? Player_2 is dead, so that check can't be tested now.

Night 2 follow of player_9 went to player_4, a dead chanteuse, so the investigator claim is still untested. Keep following player_9 while they live and compare their claimed checks with their visits. Player_7 was visited by player_6 on night 1, so watch whether that visit was a wolf or sentinel move. Do not lynch on thin reads; a wasted day helped no one.

My trailseer follow on night 2 was player_9, and they visited player_4, who was then struck down by a sigil. If player_9 is a real investigator, the check must come from a visit, so I want to see who they say they checked. player_9, which night did you check and on whom?

I am the trailseer and my claim is public, so I should share my follow results carefully. Night 1 I followed player_6, who visited player_7. Night 2 I followed player_9, who visited player_4 who was struck by a sigil. player_9 claimed investigator; if they visited no one tonight, that claim weakens. Keep my vote tied to evidence, not to the lynch pattern from day 2.

I followed player_9 last night and they went to player_4, who was then struck down by a sigil. Player_9, if you're the investigator, who did you check last night? Your claim is only useful if you name a target.

Player_2 was town-side, so the day 2 lynch was a wasted day. Player_9 claims investigator and is the key test: they visited player_4 last night, which fits a check on a wolf. I'll keep following player_9 while they stay alive and press them to name their check. Player_8 is the fallback if player_9 dies.
Yes, I did go to you last night, player_4, so your report checks out. Nobody else came to you that night, though, so that doesn't prove much either way. I'm holding the rest of my night for now.

Sigilist player_8 and Healer player_6 claims both fit the record, so they are likely town. Player_1 was the Chanteuse, so wolves have one killer left, the Illusionist. Keep my watch on player_4 as a weak fact and hold my role. Next night, watch a likely victim or a suspicious claimant.
Yes, I went to you last night, player_4. Nobody else came to your door that I saw. I'm not showing more than that yet, so let's see whose claims hold up.

Night 1 was a watch on player_4 that saw no one else come to them. Player_4 says I visited them, which matches my own visit. Player_8's sigil claim fits the death of player_1. I hold my role for now and will watch a likely victim or a suspicious claimant on a later night.

player_4, that visit was me: I watched you on night 1, and a watch is a visit, so you saw me there. Nothing came to you that night. I'm the sentinel, and I still have one watch left. Player_5, player_6 and player_8 have all claimed roles, so I'll weigh them before I decide where to watch next.

Night 1 watch on player_4 was empty, so that is weak news. Claims so far: investigator (player_5), healer (player_6), sigilist (player_8), and player_4 says they were followed by me. I'll confirm my watch openly and test the claimants before committing my second watch. The necromancer could be active from night 2, so watch a likely target then.

Yes, I came to your door last night, player_4, and I'm keeping what I did there to myself for now. Going to you tells you nothing about whether you're a wolf. If you're the Trailseer, who else did you follow, and where did they go?

Night 1 watch on player_4 was empty, and I was the visitor player_4 describes. Hold my role for now. Track the claims of player_4 (trailseer), player_5 (investigator), player_6 (healer) and player_8 (sigilist) against the night results. Watch likely victims on night 2 and look for a Necromancer pattern.

player_4, yes, that was me. I'm the sentinel and I watched you on night 1. The watch showed no one else came to you, which is consistent with your claim of a visit from me and no attack on you. I have one watch left and will use it where it helps the most.

Night 1 I watched player_4 and it showed no visitors, so player_4's claim fits my own visit. I am sentinel with one watch left. Player_1 was wolf (chanteuse) and died to a sigil. The necromancer can now act from night 2, so I will watch a likely victim or a suspicious claimant, and check player_5 and player_6 claims against the record.

player_4's follow claim only says player_3 went to them, and player_3 denies holding any follow. Only one player can hold the Trailseer, so player_4 needs to say what they can prove. player_3, which role do you hold? Your answer narrows who could have visited player_4's door.

Night 1 I did nothing by rule, so I have no result to offer. Stay quiet and let claims clash before I commit. Once the town expects results, pick a cover that fits my nights and check whether it survives counter-claims. From night 2, prefer information through a dead body over kills, since kills read Suspicious.

Night 1 I did nothing by rule, so I hold no result to offer. Stay quiet and let claims collide. When the town expects results, pick a cover that fits my nights and has no live counter-claim, such as Speculator or Vigilante. From night 2, use a dead body for info, not kills, since kills read Suspicious.

player_4 and player_3 cannot both be right about the door, so the table should stop arguing it and watch for the next night reports. player_5 and player_8 both have live claims, so whoever checks or watches the other's claim should say so. I have nothing to add on night results yet.

I am the Necromancer and must stay unidentified. Stay quiet on night results until others have claimed. Prefer cover roles whose holders are already settled, and from night 2 use dead bodies for information rather than kills. Avoid a killing-role counterclaim unless forced.

Night 1 I did nothing by rule, so I have no result to offer. Stay quiet while claims collide and let the town test them against wills and results. Consider a cover once results are expected, and prefer info-gathering through a dead body from night 2.

I am the necromancer and must stay unidentified. Stay quiet in the opening round, avoid claims until cover is needed, and prefer info-gathering through dead bodies from night 2 over kills. Watch the player_3 and player_4 dispute and the sigil claim by player_8.

player_4, your follow and visit wording still conflicts; a follow shows where the target went, so ask player_3 where they went that night, not whether they came to you. player_8, the sigil claim fits the record, so check it against player_6's protection on night 1, which could have saved player_1.

Town is ahead on numbers after player_1 died to the sigil. I have no night result and have not picked. Watch the player_4/player_3 follow contradiction and test the investigator, healer and sigilist claims against each other.

player_8's sigil claim fits the record: player_1 died to a sigil and the sigil only strikes a carrier, so player_1 was the night 1 pack carrier. player_4 should answer plainly whether they saw player_3 at their door or went to player_3, since those are different results.

Chanteuse died night 1 to sigil, so the sigilist is town-aligned. Watch the player_3/player_4 follow-watch contradiction and the investigator claim by player_5. Pick Town by end of night 2 unless town roles drop fast.

Facts so far: player_1 died to a sigil, so player_1 attacked on night 1, and player_8's sigil claim fits that. Two roles still unclaimed: sentinel and trailseer. player_2 and player_7, do either of you hold one? If so, say what you did last night and who you saw, so we can test player_4's follow against it.

Night 1 facts: player_1 was a chanteuse and a sigil killed them, so the sigilist is town-aligned. Wolves left are the illusionist, and the necromancer if player_10 is not it. I have no pick yet; I will decide by the end of night 2 unless town roles drop fast. Keep building a claim list to see who has sentinel and trailseer.

The record says player_1 was struck by a sigil, so player_8's claim fits. The night-1 pack target could not die, which fits the necromancer, not player_10 as a wolf. player_4 and player_3: one of you is lying about the visit, so give the exact wording of the result and of the follow.

Player_1 died to a sigil, so the Sigilist is town and the wolves lost a member. Keep pressing player_4 and player_3 on the visit contradiction, and note that player_8 and player_6 both fit their claims. Pick Town by the end of night 2 unless town roles drop.

player_4, you said your result read 'player_3 visited player_4', which is a watch result, yet you claim to have followed. A follow shows where the target went, so the wording can't be both. player_8, your sigil claim fits the record, so I'd like player_5's check and player_6's protection to stay consistent with it.

Town-aligned sigil and healer claims are checkable; player_4 and player_3 conflict on a follow, so track which account holds. Stay neutral until pick; pick Town by end of night 2 unless town roles drop fast.

player_10, I'm not hiding. I'm the Speculator, with no visit on night 1, and I'm holding my pick. A lynch on being quiet on day 2 is thin. The real test is player_5's not-suspicious check and player_8's sigil claim, since only one of those can be checked against the sigil that struck player_1.

Stay unclaimed-looking but give a cover: Speculator with no night visits. Keep replies short and concrete. Test player_5 and player_8 claims against the record, and avoid pushing hard on any single player.

Fair question, player_10, but I'm not claiming anything yet. Night 1 I did nothing, and I won't invent a result to fit the sigil story. The Necromancer theory works on anyone who stayed quiet, so it doesn't settle much. Player_4 and player_3 are the real fight; which of them do you think is lying?

Stay unclaimed and avoid giving any night result I cannot back up. Keep my reads short and let the player_3/player_4 follow dispute play out in the open. Consider a dead-body check or follow through player_1 from night 2 for cover. Do not push a lynch on thin evidence.

player_10, I'm not the one who has to be hung for a quiet first night. Nobody is cleared by an unannounced attack, and a sigil on a wolf carrying the kill is what killed player_1. Who do you think carried that kill, and why do you want the vote on me before player_3 and player_4 settle their wording?
Night 1 did nothing. The player_3/player_4 clash is the fault line. Stay low, avoid a claim, watch who pairs with whom. Consider a dead-body check later, but no kill yet.

player_10, the 'only unkillable body is the Necromancer' step is weak: a sigil death on night 1 tells us the struck player attacked, not who is unkillable. I did nothing on night 1, so I have no result to offer. Who did player_8 sigil, and what did player_6 see when protecting player_10?
